Name of the Material/Component: Ai-Thinker ESP32-A1S Audio Kit v2.2 (ES8388 codec)
Additional Note: The pet's main board: ESP32 with 4 MB flash and 4 MB PSRAM, ES8388 codec, speaker amp, headphone jack, microSD slot, CP2102 USB. Bought from Probots (Rs 2,499). Several look-alike revisions exist; see HARDWARE.md
The pet's screen. Sold as ILI9341; works with the ST7789 driver. Wired to its own SPI bus (see Electronics/README.md)
FAT32. Holds stories/ (WAV) and media/ (MJPEG + WAV)
Volume button on MTDI (GPIO 12), wired to 3.3 V. Two more can go across KEY1 and KEY3
Planned: on the battery's + wire, for a real off
Must carry data, not charge only (our first blocker)
Optional: early test screen, used instead of the TFT (PET_SCREEN_OLED 1)
